en.title: Turn a short order into JSON without an account
en.summary: We tested a two-turn text task in Duck.ai: structure an order, then change the quantity while keeping the unit price. The chat opened and returned both answers without requiring an account.
en.input: Return valid JSON for a notebook order: quantity 3, unit_price_usd 4.50, total_usd.
steps: Open Duck.ai and enter the sample in the chat box. In this test the selected model was GPT-6 Luna; the available models may change.
Submit the prompt. Check that the response contains quantity, unit_price_usd and total_usd.
Send the follow-up: “Change quantity to 4 and recalculate the total. Return valid JSON only.”
en.result: The first response gave total_usd 13.50. The follow-up retained unit_price_usd 4.50 and returned quantity 4 with total_usd 18.00. Both responses used JSON syntax, and the second answer preserved the earlier context.
en.limitations: This was a small text and arithmetic task, not a general accuracy benchmark. Model output can be wrong. Duck.ai sends chats to remote model providers through DuckDuckGo; it is not an offline or local-inference tool. Export and attachment handling were not verified in this test.

screenshot.alt: Duck.ai returns quantity 4, unit_price_usd 4.50 and total_usd 18.00 for the follow-up prompt.

sources.label: DuckDuckGo: information shared with model providers

zh.title: 免注册把订单文字转成 JSON
zh.summary: 我们在 Duck.ai 中完成了两轮文字任务：先把订单转成结构化数据，再修改数量并保留单价。打开对话和获取两次回答都没有遇到账号要求。
zh.input: Return valid JSON for a notebook order: quantity 3, unit_price_usd 4.50, total_usd.
steps: 打开 Duck.ai，在对话框中输入这段样例。本次选中的模型是 GPT-6 Luna；可用模型可能变化。
提交问题，检查回答是否包含 quantity、unit_price_usd 和 total_usd。
继续输入：“Change quantity to 4 and recalculate the total. Return valid JSON only.”
zh.result: 第一轮回答的总价为 13.50。第二轮保留了 4.50 的单价，将数量改为 4，总价更新为 18.00。两次回答都使用 JSON 语法，第二次回答也保留了上文的订单信息。
zh.limitations: 这次只测试了简短的文字与算术任务，不能代表模型的整体准确率。模型仍可能出错。Duck.ai 经由 DuckDuckGo 将对话发送给远程模型服务商，并非离线或本地推理工具。本次尚未验证导出和附件处理。

screenshot.alt: Duck.ai 在追问后返回数量 4、单价 4.50、总价 18.00 的 JSON。

sources.label: DuckDuckGo：与模型服务商共享的信息
